Maya K: Quick idea — run a Regional Facilitators 'Open Table' series next week for APAC / EU / NA staggered sessions. Short 45m slots, focused Q&A + live troubleshooting. Poll link: https://rwd.co/open-table-poll
Carlos R: Love it. Can we reserve one slot specifically for Dedicated migrations? A few accounts flagged infra/network questions.
Ava S: Yes — and suggest an "office-hours lite" 25m slot for fast config checks so we don't clog the deep-dive sessions.
Liam T: Timezone note — APAC-friendly window would be ~22:00–01:00 UTC (evening APAC, morning NA). EU prefers late morning UTC.
Maya K: Agenda sketch (flexible):
```
- 5m quick intros + outcomes
- 10m common blockers (onboarding keys, VPC/KMS, model pinning)
- 20m live triage / demo (bring 1 customer case)
- 10m next steps & resources / follow-ups
```
Zoe (CS-Bot): Poll created: https://rwd.co/poll/abc123 — please pick preferred region/time by EOD Thu :calendar:
Carlos R: I'm happy to own the Dedicated-migration slot. Prefer EU midday (13:00–13:45 UTC).
Ava S: I'll take NA evening slot (try for 02:00–02:45 UTC? — that's 18:00 PT). Can co-host APAC if needed.
Liam T: I can do APAC late slot but need someone to co-host for handoffs — @Ava S would that work?
Ava S: Yep I can co-host APAC (23:30 UTC start is fine).
Maya K: Capacity question: limit to 6 customers for pilot or open to 12? Smaller groups = better triage. Thoughts?
Carlos R: Start with 6 for first two runs, then scale.
Liam T: Agreed. Easier to surface renewal-risk items in a smaller room.
Maya K: Host runbook link: https://confluence.redwood/open-table-runbook — please follow 'preflight' checklist before session.
Zoe (CS-Bot): Calendar invites queued based on poll responses. Sample invite title: "Redwood Open Table — APAC late — 45m"
calendar-bot: Created event 4765432135 in calendar 'CS Open Table' (guests: Maya K, Ava S, Liam T, Carlos R)
Maya K: Follow-up owners (assigning):
- Pre-session preflight checklist: Carlos R
- Demo snippets & cheatsheet: Ava S
- Customer follow-ups / renewal flags: Maya K
Ava S: I'll draft a 1-page cheatsheet (common CLI snippets + config tips) and drop in #customer-success by EOD Fri.
Carlos R: Add a 'renewal-risk' tag in the notes if customer mentions infra blockers or SLA gating items.
Maya K: Great. Final operational ask: if you're on a waitlist or want to swap slots, post here and we'll redistribute.
Liam T: Adding 3 customers to the waitlist now (they asked for APAC late).
Maya K: Thanks team :raised_hands: We'll finalize times after poll closes and push calendar + RSVP template. End of thread.
